parts.t: Ladner Elementary is an MLS® area name in Ladner, around the school and the village core. The village has heritage conservation areas, so check whether a property has heritage rules.

Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, on October 11, 2026. I have worked in Lower Mainland real estate for 11+ years. Facts come from the official sources noted on this page. Rules and boundaries change, so confirm anything important with the City of Delta.
Not legal, planning or financial advice. Confirm zoning, plan designations and school catchments before you buy or sell.

Delta adopted a new Official Community Plan in 2024. Zoning and the plan designation apply lot by lot.

Lots zoned for single detached or duplex homes can have up to 3 units (lots up to 280 square metres) or 4 units (larger lots), plus a secondary suite and coach or garden suites within the unit limits.
Ladner Village has a Development Permit Area with form and character, flood hazard and conservation guidelines, including a flood-risk covenant requirement.
Changes inside a heritage conservation area need a heritage alteration permit.
